On the clear azure surface of the lake,

stood a four-armed man in silence. He was only 1.67 meters tall, yet his invisible aura was vast and immeasurable, his four arms hinting at a disharmony with the surrounding world.

“Four Divine Kings.”

“Four Divine Kings.”

“Four Divine Kings.”

...

At the edge of the lake, dozens of figures whispered in a frenzied tone.

Two hundred years ago, the power of the Four Divine Kings had already far surpassed theirs.

Another two hundred years had passed, and the gap had only widened further.

“Is the celestial gate about to open?”

The Four Divine Kings, the four-armed man, slowly opened his eyes, which were profound as he spoke calmly.

“According to the time in this Two-dimensional World, in two months the celestial gate will open,” the leading figure at the shore immediately responded.

The celestial gate opens every ten thousand years, which is the grandest event in this Two-dimensional World. Countless powerhouses will go to witness it.

Before the arrival of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, only those at the Witch Emperor level were qualified to vie for entry, and only the Witch Ancestor level would dare to ensure they could reach the celestial gate.

Now, with the intervention of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, the threshold has been raised infinitely.

“Understood.”

“We will set off for the Heavenly Mountain in one day,” the Four Divine Kings said slowly.

The Heavenly Mountain is the most towering peak in this known Two-dimensional World; every time the celestial gate opens, it appears above the Heavenly Mountain, which eventually led to its name.

“Yes.”

The dozens of figures at the lake’s edge nodded immediately.

“Four Divine Kings… we…” The leading figure suddenly hesitated.

“Don’t worry, you have handled so many trifles for me in this Two-dimensional World. As long as I can leave, I will have a Supreme Being make a move and compensate you for your fundamental losses as much as possible,” the Four Divine Kings assured, looking at the many figures on the shore.

These figures were all powerful and special beings, Ancient Gods who could dominate any part of the Cosmic Starry Skies.

“Many thanks, Four Divine Kings.”

“We are in your debt, Four Divine Kings.”

“It is our honor to handle trifles for the Four Divine Kings.”

The dozens of figures felt a slight relief in their hearts. Fundamental losses were irrevocable, but they could be compensated.

As long as a Supreme Being made a move, and with a price paid, their losses could be reduced to a minimum.

Of course, the Supreme Being was willing to act because the Four Divine Kings would take all the extraordinary items from the Two-dimensional World with them, and these items were partly their contribution.

“With the power of the Four Divine Kings, who in this Two-dimensional World could rival you?” the leading figure spoke.

The other figures agreed in unison.

Although they were all Eleventh-Rank special beings, they knew they had no hope of leaving, first and foremost because they could not compete with the Four Divine Kings before them.

As for giving up this celestial gate opening and waiting for the next? That was a matter for the nine strongest among them, not relevant to these somewhat mediocre special beings.

And the current nine strongest beings of the Two-dimensional World, all have similar status and are not subordinate to each other. Even if they were special beings, it was not possible.

“Alright.”

“You go down first and prepare,” said the Four Divine Kings. The figures quickly turned and left the lakeshore.

Suddenly, the wide expanse of the lake was left with only the Four Divine Kings.

“For two hundred years, I’ve done my best to tap into the potential power of the ultimate weapon within me. In terms of combat power, I estimate that I have reached the upper limit of this Two-dimensional World,” the Four Divine Kings thought silently to himself.

Unlike the wonders of the Two-dimensional World, his ultimate weapon had been brought from the outside world.

This created a fundamental difference from the magical artifacts held by the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

That is, the Four Divine Kings’ ultimate weapon had been refined.

The other Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses, even if they possessed magical artifacts as powerful as the Four Divine Kings’ ultimate weapon, could not refine them. They could only exert the lowest level of their power.

Inside the Two-dimensional World, many of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses’ techniques could not be executed, unable to refine magical artifacts.

But the Four Divine Kings’ ultimate weapon had already been refined before entering this world.

Even though having fallen into the Two-dimensional World meant that many powers of the ultimate weapon were suppressed, the Four Divine Kings were able to unite his mind with the refined weapon, and he slowly developed more of its powers.

And this ultimate weapon was perfectly suited for the Four Divine Kings, allowing the full extent of the highest combat power to be exerted.

“This time the celestial gate opens, I must be able to leave,” the Four Divine Kings was filled with confidence. As a Level Eleven Perfect legendary being, he was already among the strongest of the many powerhouses of the Myriad Tribes, especially with his ultimate weapon in hand.

With such a significant advantage, if he still couldn’t leave… the Four Divine Kings did not consider this a possibility.

…

In a volcano, before the boiling magma,

a thin old man sat cross-legged, his figure like a seething flame, with the temperature around him soaring and the rock walls beginning to melt.

“That’s about enough,”

“I have reached a limit,” the thin old man exhaled lightly, and the temperatures nearby began to cool rapidly, “It’s time to head to the Heavenly Mountain.”

The old man narrowed his eyes slightly, “This time, during the opening of the celestial gate, the only ones who can contend with me are a few old fellows, including the Four Divine Kings. He brought a true ultimate weapon with him, indeed difficult to deal with.”

The thin old man stroked his chin, deep in thought.

Normally, Tier 11 beings do not qualify to possess an ultimate weapon, even if they are Level Eleven Perfect legendary beings.

Even for the Peak Clans, an ultimate weapon is a part of their heritage, and a Tier 11 lifeform possessing one might likely attract a Supreme Being to seize it.
